startup.error.title: Data file
instance.unguarded.title: Single-instance check unavailable
instance.unguarded.message: Concentrator could not check whether it is already running. If another Concentrator window is open, close one of them: both would save to the same data file and overwrite each other's changes.
external_change.title: Data file changed
external_change.message:
The data file was changed outside Concentrator since it was last loaded or saved.

Reload the file: the changes made in Concentrator since the last save are lost.
Keep Concentrator's version: the file is overwritten; its current content is kept in the .bak copy next to it.
external_change.reload_failed: The changed file cannot be loaded. Fix it, or keep Concentrator's version.
shutdown.failed.title: Changes not saved
shutdown.changed.message:
The data file was changed outside Concentrator while your latest changes were waiting to be saved.

Keep Concentrator's version: the file is overwritten (its current content goes to the .bak copy), then Concentrator closes.
Quit without saving: the file keeps the outside changes.
